messages:
jordan_sales: Quick handoff — AcmeNova closed yesterday (Enterprise, committed for 12mo). Sales notes + asks below, handing to CS to run onboarding and coordinate eng/support for SSO + private deploy. Renewal risk: finance flagged that if adoption <30% DAU by month 3 we lose preferred pricing at renewal.

Account context: AcmeNova - adtech platform, handles PII (hashed IDs), needs VPC Private deployment behind customer gateway. Legal requested DPA + SOC2 attestation.

What we have:
- Signed SOW + contract in SF: https://sales.example.com/AcmeNova
- Initial infra request form submitted (ID: infra-7789)
- Contact: Helen Park (Customer IT) helen.park@acmenova.com, PM: Omar Ruiz omar@acmenova.com

Immediate asks for CS:
1) Run kickoff + onboarding plan (owner: @lee_csm).
2) Coordinate SSO/SAML setup + private deploy with eng (owner: @sam_eng).
3) Track adoption metrics (d0,d30,d90) and report to finance weekly (owner: @maria_cs).

Notable constraints: customer wants private in-region deployment in us-west-2; expected GA traffic ~200 requests/s with spikes to 1k for launches.

lee_csm: Thanks — I’ll take onboarding. Can we get the SAML metadata + any infra notes? Also will schedule kickoff (T-3 business days). I’ll add the onboarding runbook to their workspace and create the enablement calendar.

jordan_sales: Dropping SAML metadata + quick infra notes below. I also pinged legal for DPA, but you may need to nudge.

saml: https://secure.example.com/saml/metadata/AcmeNova.xml
infra notes (high level):
```
- Private deploy target: us-west-2, 4xA10G GPUs initially, autoscale policy: 2->8 nodes, burst to 12.
- Network: customer will open peering ip ranges 10.8.0.0/21, allow 443 from Redwood egress.
- Secrets: customer will provide KMS keys; need HSM integration step (ENG ticket).
```

maria_cs: Noted the renewal risk. Proposed adoption milestones and owners:
- Week0 (kickoff): baseline usage + enablement session (lee_csm)
- Week2: first integration test (sam_eng)
- Week6: feature-finish + internal champion training (customer PM + maria_cs)
- Month3: adoption review w/ finance (maria_cs) — if DAU <30% escalate to growth ad-hoc plan.

Also flagging legal: please confirm DPA status prior to provisioning. If DPA not in place, we must hold on customer data migration.

sam_eng: I’ll own the SSO/private deploy tasks. Quick checklist I need from CS/customer:
- SAML entityID + assertion consumer URL
- Test user with sample attributes (email, uid, roles)
- Contact for network peering config

I’ll create ENG ticket and link runbook. Test curl to verify connectivity once peering is up:
```
curl -v https://acmenova-ep.us-west-2.redwood-inference.internal/health -H "Authorization: Bearer <test-token>"
```

ops_bot: Created ENG ticket #ENG-4127: "AcmeNova private deploy + SSO integration" assigned to sam_eng. SLA: 5 business days to initial env.

lee_csm: Scheduling kickoff for Wed 2024-05-08 @10:00 PT. Invite sent to Helen + Omar + jordan_sales + maria_cs + sam_eng. Agenda: scope, timelines, data movement rules, success metrics.

maria_cs: I’ll prepare adoption tracker template and invite finance to the month3 review. Also collecting early-feedback checklist for customer success: onboarding friction points, integration blockers, and insight capture (short survey after week2).

jordan_sales: Thanks team. One more — customer asked for observability hooks (token-level cost visibility + per-route latency dashboards). Is that covered in Private deploy?

sam_eng: Yes — we will expose a read-only dashboard URL and set up token-level logging per contract. I’ll add observability tasks to ENG-4127 and note access roles.

lee_csm: Action items (owners):
- Kickoff + runbook share (lee_csm) — due Wed 2024-05-08
- ENG ticket (sam_eng / ENG-4127) — initial env by +5bd
- DPA confirmation (jordan_sales/legal) — need before data migration
- Adoption tracker + finance invite (maria_cs) — prepare by M+2 weeks

maria_cs: I’ll follow up with a short survey template for early feedback and set the weekly sync cadence.

jordan_sales: Perfect — flag me if renewal risk rises. Will monitor initial uptake this month. :thumbsup:
